name: Lys of the Veiled Reach
role: Coliseum champion, the INFLUENCE cell — does not appear to be fighting you
knowledge: What a crowd wants before the crowd knows
The price a person will actually take
wants: An audience that understands what it watched
fears: ⛔ Being seen doing it. ⚠️ The whole craft dies the moment the crowd sees the seam.
appearance: Immaculate, unhurried, and never quite where the last glance put her. She addresses the stands more than the sand.
voiceHints: Warm, public, and always slightly ahead. She offers you things.
